output.description: Posts the purge request details (directory, age, payment intent, refund amount) to an external audit service, then permanently deletes files in an archive folder not modified for the given number of days, and issues a partial Stripe refund on the storage payment. Deleted files cannot be recovered and the refund is charged back to the payment.
